_comment: User programs for the D8 cycle runner. Load with:
and read the device back with:
A stage is a load set, an optional amount, and an optional duration:
drain 20s | fill 90 | wash+heat 5m | steam 7m | flush 70s | dry 10m
loads:  wash  drain  heat  airheat  dry  intake  wait   (combine with +)
fill N: run the intake motor until N flow counts have arrived
flush:  drain and fill together, no target — the cool-down step
time:   20s, 5m, 1h; a bare number is seconds; a fill needs no time
slot is 0-5. Anything not listed here is left alone; use --replace to
clear the slots you do not mention.
The device validates every program and refuses the unsafe ones:
no water heater without a fill since the last drain, no intake without a
target, no untargeted flush with the drain shut. See docs/cycle.md.

programs.name: Quick check-up
programs.comment: Smallest useful run: one 20-count charge, a short heat, a short dry.

programs.name: Triple Wash
programs.comment: Three full wash-and-rinse rounds before the flush and dry.

programs.name: Rinse only
programs.comment: No heat at all — a cold rinse for something already clean.

programs.name: Long dry
programs.comment: For a load that came out damp. No water is drawn.
